# netboxplugins_dns_view (Data Source)

Reads one NetBox DNS view.

Plugin: `netbox-plugin-dns` (experimental). API: `/api/plugins/netbox-dns/views/`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netboxplugins_dns_view" "by_id" {
  id = 42
}

data "netboxplugins_dns_view" "by_filter" {
  filters = { name = "example" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) NetBox query parameters on `/api/plugins/netbox-dns/views/` that select exactly one object, for example `{ name = "example" }`.
- `id` (Number) NetBox ID of the object. Set either `id` or `filters`.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values as strings; lists and objects as JSON (`jsonencode`).
- `default_view` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `ip_address_filter` (String) JSON value (`jsonencode`).
- `name` (String)
- `owner` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
- `prefixes` (Set of Number) IPAM Prefixes assigned to the View. NetBox IDs of the referenced objects.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tag names.
- `tenant` (Number) NetBox ID of the referenced object.
